async def w01(items, rows, out, read):
    # CASE bare_tuple_index_uses_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        out[saved], count = rows[item]


async def w02(items, rows, out, read):
    # CASE paren_tuple_index_uses_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        (out[saved], count) = rows[item]


async def w03(items, rows, read):
    # CASE bare_tuple_attr_of_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        saved.value, count = rows[item]


async def w04(items, rows, read):
    # CASE list_attr_of_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        [saved.value, count] = rows[item]


async def w05(items, rows, read):
    # CASE name_first_tuple_attr expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        count, saved.value = rows[item]
